title: Slab · Headless Web Components
author: Tony Ward
summary: Slab is a library of 32 headless Web Components that handle keyboard interaction, focus, ARIA, forms, and events on top of native HTML elements. It works with frameworks or plain HTML and leaves visual styling to developers through CSS parts and states.

title: Introducing A2UI: An open project for agent-driven interfaces
author: Google A2UI Team
summary: Google introduces A2UI, an open-source declarative format for agents to generate and update interfaces across applications and UI frameworks. Agents send structured messages describing trusted components rather than executable code, leaving rendering, styling, and security controls with the host application. The article explains its integration with A2A and AG-UI and its differences from MCP Apps and platform-specific tools.

title: Brad Frost's Agent Skills
author: Brad Frost
summary: A collection of AI agent skills for design-system evaluation, product inspection, design-token architecture, and UI development. It also includes tools for setting AI usage boundaries, such as session caps, quiet hours, and definitive session endings, with enforcement capabilities documented for each supported platform.

title: Figma Console MCP Server
author: southleft
summary: An MCP server that connects AI assistants to Figma for design-system extraction, design creation and editing, debugging, and bidirectional design-token synchronization. It also supports accessibility checks, design-system audits, FigJam boards, and Figma Slides, with capabilities varying by connection mode.

title: Leadership OS starter
author: alliethu
summary: A Markdown-first repository template for maintaining leadership context, decisions, commitments, and ongoing work. It provides profiles, logs, templates, and focused AI skills for coaching, weekly reviews, product design, and technical analysis, designed for GitHub Copilot while remaining portable. Workflows emphasize evidence, privacy, and human approval rather than autonomous decisions or automated integrations.
